description.zh:
要替换的新的资源组ID。

> 资源组是在阿里云账号下进行资源分组管理的一种机制，资源组能够帮助您解决单个云账号内的资源分组和授权管理等复杂性问题。更多信息，请参见[什么是资源管理](~~94475~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the new resource group.

>  You can use resource groups to manage resources within your Alibaba Cloud account by group. This helps you resolve issues such as resource grouping and permission management for your Alibaba Cloud account. For more information, see [What is Resource Management?](~~94475~~)

description.zh:
要修改的资源组所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The ID of the region to which the new resource group belongs.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to obtain the region ID.

description.zh: 待修改资源组的物理专线资源ID。
description.en: The ID of the Express Connect circuit whose resource group you want to modify.

description.zh:
资源类型。取值：
- **PHYSICALCONNECTION**：表示高速通道专线实例。
- **VIRTUALBORDERROUTER**：表示边界路由器。
- **ROUTERINTERFACE**：表示VBR上连。
- **TRAFFICQOS**：表示QoS策略。
description.en:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

*   **PHYSICALCONNECTION**: Express Connect circuit.
*   **VIRTUALBORDERROUTER**: virtual border router (VBR).
*   **ROUTERINTERFACE**: router interface.

title.zh: 修改物理专线资源所属的资源组

descriptions.zh: **ChangeResourceGroup**接口不支持在同一个物理专线实例内并发修改物理专线资源所属的资源组。
descriptions.en:
## [](#)

You cannot repeatedly call the **ChangeResourceGroup** operation to modify the resource group of the same Express Connect circuit.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc change-resource-group --new-resource-group-id rg-bp1drpcfz9srr393h0000 --resource-type PHYSICALCONNECTION --resource-id pc-bp16qjewdsunr41m10000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
